specification.name: NCTD Manifest Parser

extends.rule: All v2.7.1 rules remain active. This version only adds the optional consecutive numbering of Leg ID V2.

specification.description: v2.8.0 overlay: optional consecutive Leg ID V2 values L000001, L000002, ... for every Output row, starting at a number entered by the user.

changes: Added LEG-ID-V2-SEQUENTIAL-001: checkbox "Asignar números consecutivos a Leg ID V2", off by default. When on, Leg ID V2 = L + six-digit consecutive number, in Output row order.
The user enters the start number (field "Iniciar en", default 1) to continue the previous file's numbering, so numbers do not repeat across days (decision 2026-11-15).

When the option is on, the Leg ID V2 formula (CLI -> Leg ID, PCA/COM/COMP -> Vendor ID), the invariant "Do not append a counter or random value" and VAL-013/VAL-014 do not apply to Leg ID V2. Vendor ID, Leg ID, Tobi MRN, Pair Status and the catalog do not change.
Added acceptance tests AT-54 to AT-58.

label.es: Asignar números consecutivos a Leg ID V2
label.en: Assign consecutive numbers to Leg ID V2

start.continuity: To avoid repeating identifiers in TOBI across files, enter the last number of the previous file + 1. The summary shows the next start number. Planned: remember it in the passenger database.

sequential_option.order: Output row order (the same order as the Output file and the Section 2 grid).
sequential_option.scope: Every valid Output row after exact deduplication, Vendor ID, Leg ID and the standard Leg ID V2 formula; the consecutive value replaces Leg ID V2.
sequential_option.independent_of: TOBI_INDEPENDENT_LEGS_V2 mode: the numbering can be used with the experimental mode on or off; the Leg ID V2 checks keep their severity rules.
overrides_when_enabled: experimental_rules.leg_id_v2.rules (CLI -> Leg ID, PCA/COM/COMP -> Vendor ID)
invariant: Do not append a counter or random value (Leg ID V2 only)
sequential_option.determinism: The same Source file, catalog, options and start number give the same values. Adding, removing or reordering rows changes the numbers of the rows that follow.

overflow.action: Do not produce the Output file.

sequential_option.invalid_start: A start number that is not a whole number from 1 to 999999 is rejected before processing.

validations_patch.assertion: With LEG-ID-V2-SEQUENTIAL-001 on, every Leg ID V2 matches ^L[0-9]{6}$, the first equals the start number and each following row adds 1, in Output row order.

acceptance_tests_patch.case: Consecutive option on, start 1, three Output rows

acceptance_tests_patch.expected: First Leg ID V2 is L000093; the summary shows the next start number
Vendor ID, Leg ID, Tobi MRN, Pair Status and the catalog are identical to the run with the option off

acceptance_tests_patch.case: Start number plus Output rows exceeds 999999

consistency_contract_patch.acceptance_test_id_range: AT-01..AT-58 with no gaps after applying v2.5.0, v2.6.0, v2.7.0, v2.7.1 and v2.8.0
